SELECT * FROM( SELECT tmp.plan_id,plan_type,type_id,type_name,team_id,team_name,tmp.task_begin_date,task_end_date, cur_order,factory_name,IFNULL(frequency,0) frequency,IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) check_num, CASE WHEN IFNULL(frequency,0) - IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0)>=0 THEN IFNULL(frequency,0) - IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) ELSE 0 END uncheck_num, case when (frequency is null or frequency = 0 or tmp1.check_num is null) then 0 else round((tmp1.check_num*100/tmp.frequency)) end check_rate FROM (SELECT t.plan_id,p.plan_type,t.type_id,max(t.type_name) type_name, t.team_id,max(t.team_name) team_name,t.task_begin_date,max(t.task_end_date) task_end_date, max(t.cur_order) cur_order,max(m.field_name) factory_name,sum(p.frequency) frequency FROM safety_patrol_task t LEFT JOIN safety_patrol_plan p ON t.plan_id = p.id LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage m ON m.id = t.factory_id WHERE 1 = 1 and p.plan_type = 1
group by p.plan_type,t.type_id,t.team_id,t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date) tmp left join (select t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date,count(1) check_num from safety_process_patrol p,safety_patrol_task t where t.id = p.task_id GROUP BY t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date) tmp1 on tmp.plan_id = tmp1.plan_id and tmp.task_begin_date = tmp1.task_begin_date where 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT tmp.plan_id,plan_type,type_id,type_name,team_id,team_name,tmp.task_begin_date,task_end_date, cur_order,factory_name,IFNULL(frequency,0) frequency,IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) check_num, CASE WHEN IFNULL(frequency,0) - IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0)>=0 THEN IFNULL(frequency,0) - IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) ELSE 0 END uncheck_num, case when (frequency is null or frequency = 0 or tmp1.check_num is null) then 0 else round((tmp1.check_num*100/tmp.frequency)) end check_rate FROM (SELECT t.plan_id,p.plan_type,t.type_id,max(t.type_name) type_name, t.team_id,max(t.team_name) team_name,t.task_begin_date,max(t.task_end_date) task_end_date, max(t.cur_order) cur_order,max(m.field_name) factory_name,sum(p.frequency) frequency FROM safety_patrol_task t LEFT JOIN safety_patrol_plan p ON t.plan_id = p.id LEFT JOIN safety_field_manage m ON m.id = t.factory_id WHERE 1 = 1 and p.plan_type = 2
group by p.plan_type,t.type_id,t.team_id,t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date) tmp left join (select t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date,count(1) check_num from safety_validate_environment p,safety_patrol_task t where t.id = p.task_id GROUP BY t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date) tmp1 on tmp.plan_id = tmp1.plan_id and tmp.task_begin_date = tmp1.task_begin_date where 1 = 1 ) CUR_DATE where 1 = 1
and plan_type = #{planType}

select * from(
select plan_id,plan_name,plan_type,type_id,type_name,team_id,team_name,task_begin_date,task_end_date,cur_order, factory_name,factory_id,tmp.task_id,IFNULL(frequency,0) frequency,IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) check_num, CASE WHEN IFNULL(frequency,0)-IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(frequency,0)-IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) END uncheck_num, case when (frequency is null or frequency = 0 or tmp1.check_num is null) then 0 else round((tmp1.check_num*100/tmp.frequency)) end check_rate,plan_remark from (select t.plan_id,p.plan_name,p.plan_type,t.type_id,max(t.type_name) type_name,t.team_id,max(t.team_name) team_name, t.task_begin_date,max(t.task_end_date) task_end_date,max(t.cur_order) cur_order, max(m.field_name) factory_name,sum(p.frequency) frequency,t.factory_id,t.id task_id,p.remark plan_remark from safety_patrol_task t left join safety_patrol_plan p on t.plan_id = p.id left join safety_field_manage m on m.id = t.factory_id where 1 = 1 and p.plan_type = 1
group by p.plan_type,t.type_id,t.team_id,t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date,t.factory_id,t.id) tmp left join (select p.task_id,count(1) check_num from safety_process_patrol p where p.event_source = 1 group by p.task_id) tmp1 on tmp1.task_id = tmp.task_id where 1 = 1 union all
select plan_id,plan_name,plan_type,type_id,type_name,team_id,team_name,task_begin_date,task_end_date,cur_order, factory_name,factory_id,tmp.task_id,IFNULL(frequency,0) frequency,IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) check_num, CASE WHEN IFNULL(frequency,0)-IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(frequency,0)-IFNULL(tmp1.check_num,0) END uncheck_num, case when (frequency is null or frequency = 0 or tmp1.check_num is null) then 0 else round((tmp1.check_num*100/tmp.frequency)) end check_rate,plan_remark from (select t.plan_id,p.plan_name,p.plan_type,t.type_id,max(t.type_name) type_name,t.team_id,max(t.team_name) team_name, t.task_begin_date,max(t.task_end_date) task_end_date,max(t.cur_order) cur_order, max(m.field_name) factory_name,sum(p.frequency) frequency,t.factory_id,t.id task_id,p.remark plan_remark from safety_patrol_task t left join safety_patrol_plan p on t.plan_id = p.id left join safety_field_manage m on m.id = t.factory_id where 1 = 1 and p.plan_type = 2
group by p.plan_type,t.type_id,t.team_id,t.plan_id,t.task_begin_date,t.factory_id,t.id) tmp left join (select p.task_id,count(1) check_num from safety_validate_environment p where p.event_source = 1 group by p.task_id) tmp1 on tmp1.task_id = tmp.task_id where 1 = 1 ) cur_date where 1 = 1
and plan_type = #{planType}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT max(pp.plan_type) plan_type,max(event_type) type_name, p.plan_id, p.task_id, max(pp.frequency) frequency, case when count(1)> max(pp.frequency) then max(pp.frequency) else count(1) end check_num FROM safety_validate_environment p ,safety_patrol_task t ,safety_patrol_plan pp WHERE p.event_source = 1 and p.task_id = t.id and pp.id = t.plan_id
group by p.plan_id,p.task_id UNION ALL SELECT max(pp.plan_type) plan_type,max(event_type) type_name, p.plan_id, p.task_id, max(pp.frequency) frequency, case when count(1)> max(pp.frequency) then max(pp.frequency) else count(1) end check_num from safety.safety_process_patrol p ,safety_patrol_task t ,safety_patrol_plan pp where event_source = 1 and p.task_id = t.id and pp.id = t.plan_id
group by p.plan_id,p.task_id ) TMP WHERE 1 = 1
and plan_type = #{planType}
